title: Militant attack kills 11 at security check post in northern Pakistan
summary: PESHAWAR, Pakistan—Militants rammed an explosives-laden vehicle into a security check post in northern Pakistan, killing at least 11 people and wounding 18 others, police and rescue officials said…

blocks.text: PESHAWAR, Pakistan—Militants rammed an explosives-laden vehicle into a security check post in northern Pakistan, killing at least 11 people and wounding 18 others, police and rescue officials said Saturday. Saifullah Khan, a Dera Ismail Khan police official, told Agence France–Presse (AFP) that the attack on the security check post — which is jointly operated by police, military and customs personnel — took place “around noon.” “A suspected suicide bomber rammed an explosives-laden vehicle into the checkpoint, killing 11 people,” he said.
